stories.title: Beyond recruitment: What really keeps women in solar
stories.description: This week, Women in Solar+ Europe (WiSEu) shares insights from its contribution to SolarPower Europe’s EU Solar Jobs Report 2026, exploring what attracts women to Solar+ and what makes them stay, progress or leave.

stories.title: Large-scale solar projects in Australia reach record 3.5 GW of annual investment decisions
stories.description: The latest Clean Energy Regulator data shows investment in solar is setting a new annual record with solar final investment decisions for the September 2026 quarter at 1 GW, adding to 3.5 GW already achieved in 2026.

stories.title: Show HN: Sphinx – A hook that quizzes you on your AI's code before shipping
stories.description: FOSS, Basically it plugs into your existing coding agent workflow and every time you push to prod it'll throw up a questionnaire that checks if you understand how the code you're pushing works.

stories.title: Mysterious brain activity under anesthesia challenges what we know about consciousness
stories.description: Even under general anesthesia, the human brain can analyze language, recognize different types of words, and predict what comes next in a story, according to a surprising discovery by Baylor researchers. The findings challenge our understanding of consciousness and suggest that the unconscious brain is far more capable than scientists previously realized.

stories.title: A fungus is threatening the world’s food supply. Scientists just found a new defense
stories.description: Scientists have discovered a potential new weapon against a devastating fungus that threatens rice, wheat, and barley worldwide. By engineering a special type of plant immune receptor, researchers created defenses capable of recognizing multiple fungal threats at once.

stories.title: Scientists may have overlooked a hidden Alzheimer's culprit for decades
stories.description: For decades, scientists have focused on amyloid beta as a major culprit behind Alzheimer’s disease, spending billions of dollars developing treatments that have often delivered disappointing results. Now, researchers at UC Santa Cruz are drawing attention to a largely overlooked peptide called P3 that could also play a role in the disease.

stories.title: Qcells to introduce U.S. domestic frames for residential solar panel lineup
stories.description: The manufacturer partnered with Aluko Group to supply U.S.-made aluminum frames from Tennessee, aimed at streamlining domestic content bonus qualification under increasing IRA thresholds.
